children: U.S. GoldMining announced AIDEA authorized up to $25 million to fund geotechnical and engineering work for the State-led West Susitna Access Project.
AIDEA authorized up to $25 million to fund geotechnical drilling, permitting, hydrologic and engineering work for the WSAP.
Geotechnical program will provide data needed to advance final road design, bridge foundations, material sites, culvert sizing.
WSAP would link the Whistler Project to Anchorage-area road, rail, power and port infrastructure, unlocking the West Susitna Mineral District.
PEA for Whistler shows after-tax NPV5% of $2.0B and a 33% IRR based on Indicated resources; results are preliminary and not a feasibility study.
